description: This file defines a Swift actor `GatewayNodeSession` managing WebSocket connections, request handling, and event processing for a gateway node in an OpenClaw system. It includes functions for URL canonicalization, socket communication, invoking remote methods with timeouts, and managing session state.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSession
classes.description: An actor managing a session with a gateway node, handling connection lifecycle, request invocation with timeout, event subscription, and URL normalization.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeout
methods.description: Executes an async invocation with a specified timeout, returning a timed-out response if the invocation exceeds the limit.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket session with the specified URL and options, setting up handlers for connection, disconnection, and invocation.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates the current WebSocket connection and resets the session state.

methods.name: currentCanvasHostUrl
methods.description: Returns the current URL for the canvas host.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests a refresh of the node's canvas capability from the server.

methods.name: currentRemoteAddress
methods.description: Returns the current active URL with port info for the connection.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event message with payload to the server via the WebSocket channel.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an RPC call with method, params, and timeout over the WebSocket channel.

methods.name: subscribeServerEvents
methods.description: Creates an async stream to listen for server-sent events.
